name: cto-powersuit
description: CTO Powersuit: agent skills for the work of a CTO, one plugin per function. Modules for decisions, docs and the deploy gate, plus the knowledge infrastructure plugins: an output filter you calibrate to yourself, a plain-Markdown vault with local search, and stance filters.

plugins.name: compliance
plugins.description: Control map to ISO 27001, TISAX, NIS2 and GDPR by number, AI Act triage and a website legal baseline, with gate checks for security.txt and third-party requests.

plugins.name: decisions
plugins.description: RFCs, architecture decision records and a decision-log review, with templates and a gate check on ADR status, owner and date.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Docs tree with owners and review dates, runbooks, a stale-page sweep, a static docs build and a gate check on review fields.

plugins.name: finops
plugins.description: Cost baseline, showback, unit costs, SaaS stack audit and FOCUS export, with a gate check that cost figures carry a period and a source.

plugins.name: gate
plugins.description: Deploy gate: rules with pass and fail fixtures, run records, findings that close only on a passing rerun, and a workflow that deploys after the gate.

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: Alloy, Prometheus, Loki, Grafana and Alertmanager via docker compose, dashboards as code and alert routes, with a gate check on alert rules.

plugins.name: reliability
plugins.description: Availability targets, SLOs, incidents, postmortems, a static status page and on-call, with a gate check on the service catalogue.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Software delivery lifecycle: an audit for repositories built without one, the lifecycle map, tickets, review, test strategy and release, with a traceability gate check.

plugins.name: vestige
plugins.description: Output filter you calibrate to yourself. Hooks scan every reply and every Markdown write.

plugins.name: vault
plugins.description: Plain-Markdown vault with hybrid local search as an MCP server, plus seed and atomize skills.

plugins.name: stance
plugins.description: Stance filters: professional-b2, good-chad, receipts, poles, mode-leak.
